weekSummary: A hearty winter week built around chicken drumsticks and pork mince, paired with seasonal vegetables across roasts, soups, stir-fries and bakes.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Drumsticks with Roast Pumpkin and Potatoes
meals.description: Crispy baked drumsticks roasted alongside chunks of pumpkin, agria potatoes and onion with chicken gravy mix for a classic hearty winter traybake.

ingredients.name: Crown Pumpkin
ingredients.amount: 600g (about 1/4 of a pumpkin), peeled and cut into 4cm chunks

ingredients.name: Brown Onions
ingredients.amount: 2 medium (approx 200g), peeled and cut into wedges

method: Step 1: Preheat your oven to 200°C fan-bake. Line a large roasting tray with baking paper.
Step 2: Place the potato quarters and pumpkin chunks on the tray. Drizzle with the melted table spread and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat evenly, then spread into a single layer.
Step 3: Nestle the chicken drumsticks and onion wedges in among the vegetables.
Step 4: Mix the roast chicken gravy sachet with 3 tablespoons of warm water to make a thin paste. Brush or spoon this over the drumsticks and drizzle any remaining over the vegetables.

Step 5: Roast for 50–55 minutes, turning the vegetables once halfway through, until the chicken skin is golden and crispy and the potatoes and pumpkin are tender and slightly caramelised at the edges.
Step 6: Rest for 5 minutes before serving. Leftovers keep well in the fridge for up to 3 days — reheat in the oven or microwave.

meals.name: Pork Mince and Cabbage Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Savoury pork mince tossed with shredded cabbage, carrot, onion and udon noodles in a simple soy and tomato paste broth for a filling winter noodle bowl.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.amount: 2 medium (approx 200g), peeled and grated or julienned

method: Step 1: Bring a kettle to the boil. Place the udon noodles in a heatproof bowl, cover with boiling water and leave to soak for 3–4 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Step 2: Heat a large frying pan or wok over high heat. Add the pork mince and cook for 5–6 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned all over. Drain off any excess fat if needed.
Step 3: Add the diced onion to the pan and cook for 2–3 minutes until softened.
Step 4: Add the grated carrot and shredded cabbage. Stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until the cabbage has wilted and everything is well combined.
Step 5: Mix the tomato paste with 3 tablespoons of water and pour over the pan. Stir through and cook for 1–2 minutes.
Step 6: Add the drained noodles and toss everything together over high heat for 2 minutes until the noodles are heated through and coated in the sauce. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Step 7: Serve immediately in bowls. Leftovers reheat well in the microwave — add a splash of water before reheating to loosen.

meals.name: Chicken Drumstick and Vegetable Soup
meals.description: A thick, warming soup with tender drumstick meat pulled off the bone, simmered with carrot, celery, potato and onion in a chicken gravy-enriched broth.
method: Step 1: Place the drumsticks in a large pot and cover with 1.5 litres of cold water. Bring to the boil over high heat, skimming off any foam that rises to the surface.
Step 2: Add the diced onion, carrot, celery and a good pinch of salt. Reduce heat to a gentle simmer, cover partially with a lid and cook for 45 minutes.
Step 3: Remove the drumsticks from the pot and place on a board to cool for 10 minutes. Add the diced potato to the pot and continue simmering.
Step 4: Once cool enough to handle, pull the chicken meat off the bones, discarding the skin and bones. Shred the meat into bite-sized pieces.
Step 5: Mix the gravy sachet with 2 tablespoons of cold water to form a smooth paste. Stir into the simmering soup and cook for 2 minutes until slightly thickened.
Step 6: Return the shredded chicken to the pot. Simmer for a further 5 minutes until the potato is tender. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Step 7: Ladle into deep bowls and serve with bread if available. This soup thickens further overnight and is even better the next day.

meals.name: Pork Mince Pasta Bake
meals.description: Pork mince cooked down with onion and tomato paste, tossed through penne pasta with broccoli florets and a splash of milk, then baked until golden and bubbling.
method: Step 1: Preheat oven to 190°C fan-bake. Cook the penne in a large pot of well-salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than packet instructions (it will finish cooking in the oven). Add the broccoli florets to the pasta water for the last 2 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Step 2: While the pasta cooks, heat a large ovenproof frying pan or pot over medium-high heat. Add the table spread and diced onion, cooking for 3 minutes until softened.
Step 3: Add the pork mince and cook, breaking up with a spoon, for 6–8 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Step 4: Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes. Pour in the milk and 100ml of water, stir well and bring to a simmer. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Step 5: Add the drained pasta and broccoli to the mince mixture and stir to combine. Transfer to a large baking dish (approx 30x20cm) if not already using an ovenproof pan.
Step 6: Cover tightly with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil and bake for a further 10 minutes until the top starts to brown and the sauce is bubbling around the edges.
Step 7: Allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving. Leftovers are excellent — store in the fridge for up to 3 days and reheat covered in the microwave.

meals.name: Drumstick Tray Bake with Cabbage and Carrots
meals.description: Drumsticks roasted over wedges of potato, carrot and wilted cabbage with brown gravy mix drizzled over for a simple, no-fuss midweek winter dinner.

ingredients.name: Pams Brushed Agria Potatoes
ingredients.amount: 400g, scrubbed and cut into thick wedges

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.amount: 2 medium (approx 200g), peeled and cut into thick batons

ingredients.name: Green Cabbage Half
ingredients.amount: 1/4 head (approx 200g), cut into 3cm wedges through the core

method: Step 1: Preheat oven to 200°C fan-bake. Line a medium roasting tray (approx 25x35cm) with baking paper.
Step 2: Spread the potato wedges and carrot batons on the tray. Drizzle with the melted table spread, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast for 15 minutes while you prepare the rest.
Step 3: Mix the brown gravy sachet with 150ml of warm water in a small jug and stir until smooth.
Step 4: Remove the tray from the oven. Nestle the drumsticks on top of the vegetables and tuck the cabbage wedges in around them.
Step 5: Pour the gravy mix evenly over the drumsticks and vegetables, making sure everything gets a good coating.

Step 6: Return to the oven and roast for a further 35–40 minutes until the chicken skin is deep golden and the juices run clear when the thickest part is pierced. The cabbage will soften and caramelise slightly at the edges.
Step 7: Serve straight from the tray, spooning the pan juices over the top.
